use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

const NS: &str = "urn:rust-proof:records";

fn record(fields: impl IntoIterator<Item = (&'static str, Value)>) -> Value {
    Value::Record(
        fields
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(name, value)| (name.into(), value))
            .collect(),
    )
}

#[test]
fn matches_java_nested_record_and_field_outputs() {
    let amount = Value::Number {
        coefficient: "12500".into(),
        scale: 3,
    };
    for vector in 0..5 {
        let money = record([
            (
                "Amount",
                if vector == 3 {
                    Value::Null
                } else {
                    amount.clone()
                },
            ),
            ("Label", Value::Text("Grüezi 🌍".into())),
            ("Extra", Value::Text("retained".into())),
        ]);
        let balance = if vector == 2 {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            money.clone()
        };
        let account = if vector == 1 {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            record([("Balance", balance), ("Active", Value::Boolean(true))])
        };
        let applicant = if vector == 0 {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            record([
                ("Account", account),
                ("Name", Value::Text("Example".into())),
            ])
        };
        for use_balance in [false, true] {
            let input = BTreeMap::from([
                ((NS, "applicant"), applicant.clone()),
                ((NS, "use"), Value::Boolean(use_balance)),
            ]);
            let balance = if vector <= 2 {
                Value::Null
            } else {
                money.clone()
            };
            let expected_amount = if vector <= 3 {
                Value::Null
            } else {
                amount.clone()
            };
            assert_eq!(
                evaluate(&input).unwrap(),
                BTreeMap::from([
                    ((NS, "balance"), balance.clone()),
                    ((NS, "amount"), expected_amount.clone()),
                    (
                        (NS, "chosen"),
                        if use_balance { balance } else { Value::Null }
                    ),
                    (
                        (NS, "selected"),
                        if use_balance {
                            expected_amount.clone()
                        } else {
                            Value::Null
                        }
                    ),
                    (
                        (NS, "adjusted"),
                        if vector <= 3 {
                            Value::Null
                        } else {
                            Value::Number {
                                coefficient: "13750".into(),
                                scale: 3,
                            }
                        }
                    ),
                ])
            );
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn rejects_invalid_typed_record_inputs() {
    let input = |applicant| {
        BTreeMap::from([
            ((NS, "applicant"), applicant),
            ((NS, "use"), Value::Boolean(true)),
        ])
    };
    assert_eq!(
        evaluate(&input(Value::Boolean(true))),
        Err("record input type mismatch")
    );
    assert_eq!(
        evaluate(&input(record([("Name", Value::Text("Example".into()))]))),
        Err("missing record input field")
    );
    let bad_money = record([("Amount", Value::Boolean(true)), ("Label", Value::Null)]);
    let account = record([("Balance", bad_money), ("Active", Value::Null)]);
    assert_eq!(
        evaluate(&input(record([
            ("Account", account),
            ("Name", Value::Null)
        ]))),
        Err("input type mismatch")
    );
}
